en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a large harbor filled with sailing boats and steamships. A curved breakwater and piers project into the water in the foreground, while a dense cityscape stretches along the distant shoreline. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption identifying the scene as a general view of the port of Alexandria. A modern watermark with a website URL appears across the lower right.
